description: Real-time PCR (RDML, .eds, .rex, ...): one record per well and target with sample, task, Cq and Tm; compute_cq recomputes Cq, ddcq gives 2^-ΔΔCq fold changes, standard_curve fits efficiency per target.

control_sample.description: ΔΔCq control (calibrator) sample; default: the file's.

cq_method.description: How `compute_cq` computes Cq; default: `second-derivative` for LightCycler 480 `.ixo` files without a threshold or baseline window, else `threshold`. `threshold` = Where the baseline-corrected curve crosses a threshold; `stored-threshold` = A threshold crossing with only the threshold and baseline the file stores; `second-derivative` = The maximum of the second derivative, as the LightCycler 480 places its Cp.

ddcq.description: ΔΔCq relative quantification (rows: one per sample × target).

fields.description: Rows show their main fields to 4 significant digits (records: well, sample, target, cq, tm; relative_quantities: cq means, delta_cq, delta_delta_cq, rq with rq_min and rq_max). fields adds others, e.g. `["threshold"]`; `["all"]`: every field, full precision.

file.description: Path to the file or data-set directory.

reference_targets.description: ΔΔCq reference targets; default: the file's.

standard_curve.description: Standard curve per target (rows: one per target).

strict.description: Refuse values the file's assurance does not validate (exit_code 6). Default: the server's.

undetermined_cq.description: Cq for undetermined results in means and ΔΔCq; default: left out and counted.

name: openreadout_qpcr

CqComparison.description: Our Cq against the vendor's, over every curve with a vendor result.

both_undetermined.description: Both say there is no Cq.

method.description: How our Cq was computed, in words.

only_vendor.description: Only the vendor gives a Cq.

pearson_r.description: Pearson correlation of the two Cq lists.

vendor_threshold_used.description: Curves where the threshold came from the file (the vendor's own).

CqCounts.description: Cq statuses of a set of records.

excluded.description: Excluded or omitted in the file (counted in the other fields too).

no_result.description: Without any result (not analysed, setup only).

undetermined.description: Without a Cq because nothing amplified ("Undetermined").

CqMethod.description: How our Cq is computed (none of the methods reads the vendor's Cq or call).

oneOf.description: Where the baseline-corrected curve crosses a threshold.
A threshold crossing with only the threshold and baseline the file stores.
The maximum of the second derivative, as the LightCycler 480 places its Cp.

QpcrAssayRecord.description: One well × target, with names resolved.

auto_threshold.description: Whether the vendor threshold was set automatically.

baseline_end.description: Last cycle of the baseline window (vendor).

baseline_start.description: First cycle of the baseline window (vendor).

calculated_quantity.description: Quantity calculated by the vendor software from a standard curve.

computed_cq_status.description:
`determined` or `undetermined` for our Cq (with `compute_cq`; a curve that never crosses
the threshold, or crosses it only at the last read, is undetermined, and so is one that
rises too little for `second-derivative`). Absent when the method could not analyse the
curve.

cq.description: Cq (Ct) as the vendor software or RDML file reports it.

cq_mean.description: Mean Cq of the replicate group (vendor).

cq_sd.description: Standard deviation of the replicate group's Cq (vendor).

cq_status.description: `determined` (a Cq), `undetermined` (no amplification: `cq` is null) or `no result`.

cq_stored.description:
The number the file stores for an undetermined result (SDS/7500 `.eds`: the cycle
count, e.g. 40), kept for reference; never a Cq.

cq_undetermined.description:
True when the file says there is no Cq (Undetermined, `-1`, `NaN`, or an SDS/7500 `Ct`
equal to the cycle count).

cycles.description: Number of cycles in the amplification curve.

efficiency.description: Amplification efficiency of this reaction (fold per cycle), when the file has one.

excluded.description: Why the result is excluded (omitted wells, RDML `excl`).

task.description:
Role of the well for this target: `unknown`, `standard`, `ntc`, `nac`, `ntp`, `nrt`,
`positive`, ...

threshold.description: Threshold the Cq was called at (vendor).

tm.description:
Melting temperatures of the product, °C (vendor; several when the curve has several
peaks).

vendor_delta_cq.description: ΔCq to the reference target as the vendor computed it (ΔΔCt experiments).

vendor_rq.description: Relative quantity as the vendor computed it.

RelativeQuantity.description: ΔΔCq relative quantification of one sample × target.

cq_mean.description: Mean Cq of the target in this sample.

delta_cq_sd.description: SD of ΔCq (target and reference SDs combined in quadrature).

delta_delta_cq.description: ΔΔCq = ΔCq(sample) − ΔCq(control sample); `None` without a control.

efficiency_corrected_rq.description: Efficiency-corrected ratio (Pfaffl) when every efficiency involved is known.

reference_cq_mean.description: Mean Cq of the reference target(s) in this sample (arithmetic mean over references).

replicates.description:
Replicate wells averaged: those with a Cq (plus the undetermined ones when
`undetermined_cq` is given).

undetermined.description:
Replicate wells of this sample × target without a Cq (undetermined): left out of the
mean, or counted at `undetermined_cq` when the request gives one.

vendor_delta_cq.description: ΔCq the vendor software computed for these wells, when stored.

vendor_rq.description: Relative quantity the vendor software computed, when stored.

StandardCurveFit.description: A standard curve fitted to the standard wells of one target.

vendor_slope.description: The vendor's slope for this target, when the file stores its standard curve.

TargetCqSummary.description: Per-target Cq summary over the records that match the filters.

averaged.description:
Records averaged: not excluded, with a Cq (plus the undetermined ones when
`undetermined_cq` is given).

counts.description: Record counts by status (every task, excluded records included in the counts).

cq_mean.description:
Mean Cq of those records; undetermined results are left out unless `undetermined_cq`
is given.

cq_sd.description: Sample standard deviation of those Cqs.

acquisition_temperature_c.description:
Temperature of the step that reads fluorescence during cycling (the annealing /
extension temperature of a two-step PCR), °C.

cq_counts.description: Cq statuses over every record that matches the filters (not cut by `max_records`).

cycles.description: Number of PCR cycles in the program.

reference_targets.description: Reference targets used or recorded (endogenous controls).

targets.description: Per target: counts by Cq status and the mean Cq without the undetermined results.

undetermined_cq.description: Cq used for undetermined results in the aggregates, when the request gave one.
